GAME ITEM ICON. Camera above the object looking down at about sixty degrees, the way the game RimWorld draws loose items on the floor. One tidy bundle, centred, with its long axis level.

Create an ORIGINAL game item sprite for the D'thorga hot-section kit: the parts for overhauling the hottest part of a gas turbine. Image 1 is our approved service kit from the same family: match its outline weight, shading, palette and finish only. Do NOT copy its shape.

Draw ONLY the kit, alone on a plain pure white background, filling about 75 percent of the canvas. Square canvas.

An open shallow steel case: inside it a ring-shaped combustion liner with a bronze heat tint, a short row of small curved turbine blades in a foam tray, and a coil of thin silver seal wire.

Style: a sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, pale panels, rounded corners, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art. It must read clearly when shrunk to 64 pixels: three big shapes, few small ones.

No people, hands, animals, vehicles, text, letters, numbers, logos, dials, dust, floor, ground or cast shadow.
